module.description: Native date, datetime-local and two-input range fields stay authoritative; Cally adds a calendar in a first-party popover. Also a static month grid, an agenda scheduler and a checkbox availability grid.
module.name: calendar

ui.guidance: Checkboxes inside a fieldset, not clickable divs: the selection submits with no JavaScript, every slot is reachable by keyboard, and the legend associates the question with the answers. A grid of divs with click handlers has none of those properties and looks the same.
ui.name: availability-grid

ui.guidance: The input is the control. With no JavaScript the user types a date and the form submits; the platform supplies the format, the keyboard entry and the mobile date wheel. Cally adds a calendar in a first-party popover, and it writes into the same input rather than replacing it - which is why the value cannot diverge from what the server receives.
ui.keyboard: The native input keeps the platform's own keyboard entry, and Escape closes the calendar popover and returns focus to the trigger.
ui.name: date-picker
ui.summary: Renders a native date input plus an optional calendar.

ui.guidance: Two inputs rather than one string: a range submitted as one value has to be parsed and re-validated, and a partially filled range cannot be represented at all. The server owns start<=end regardless of what the calendar allowed.
ui.keyboard: The native input keeps the platform's own keyboard entry, and Escape closes the calendar popover and returns focus to the trigger.
ui.name: date-range-picker
ui.summary: Renders two native date inputs plus a range calendar.

ui.guidance: The calendar contributes only the date half. It writes nothing until a time exists too, because a datetime with a guessed midnight is a wrong answer that looks like a right one - and the user never chose it.
ui.keyboard: The native input keeps the platform's own keyboard entry, and Escape closes the calendar popover and returns focus to the trigger.
ui.name: date-time-picker
ui.summary: Renders a native datetime-local input plus a calendar.

ui.guidance: A calendar is tabular data - days across, weeks down - so it is a <table> with real column headers. A grid of divs looks identical and tells a screen reader nothing about which weekday a date falls on, which is the one thing a calendar exists to convey.
ui.name: month-grid
ui.summary: Renders a month as a table.

ui.guidance: An agenda list, not a pixel grid: a time grid positions entries by offset, which conveys duration visually and nothing at all to a screen reader, and collapses badly on a phone. The list states each entry's times as text.
ui.name: scheduler

module.title: Calendar and date pickers
